posts.name: Merrill
posts.cooked:
Hi all — I’m starting an automation service for small marketing and PR
agencies in India. Looking for an n8n builder for a paid test project,
with ongoing work if it goes well.

WHAT WE’RE BUILDING
A weekly automated client report:

  • Pull Meta Ads, Google Ads and GA4 data for multiple ad accounts
  • Store in Google Sheets or BigQuery
  • Looker Studio dashboard (one template reused across clients)
  • AI-written 3–5 line summary of week-on-week changes (OpenAI/Claude API)
  • Email delivery every Monday 9am IST (WhatsApp later)
  • Error alerts if any step fails

PAID TEST (fixed price)
One Meta Ads account + GA4 → Sheet → Looker Studio → Monday email with
AI summary + error alert. Handover via Loom walkthrough.
Budget: ₹[10,000] (~US$[115]) | Timeline: 7 days

AFTER THE TEST
New client setups (templated) + monthly maintenance retainer.
Target: 10–15 client agencies over the next 12 months.

MUST-HAVES

  • Proven work with Meta Marketing API and/or Google Ads API
  • Builds inside MY n8n, Google and Meta accounts (I own everything)
  • Documents what you build (Loom + simple diagram)
  • IST working-hours overlap; India-based preferred

TO APPLY, email [merrill.sequeira@gmail.com] with:

  1. 1–2 examples of marketing reporting / ads API work (screenshots or Loom)
  2. How you’d approach this in 5–6 lines
  3. Which tools you’d use, and roughly what my monthly bill for them would be at 5, 15 and 30 agencies (~6 ad accounts each). I pay the tools directly; I just need to know how your design affects running cost.
  4. Fixed quote for the test + hourly rate for later work
  5. Availability over the next 4 weeks

Please don’t send generic proposals — I’ll only reply to applications
that answer all 5 points.

posts.name: Максим Игошев
posts.cooked:
Hello Merrill,

  1. Experience. I have not yet built a project on the Meta Ads API or the Google Ads API, and I prefer to say that upfront. The closest thing is my lead finding system: it pulls data through APIs, writes a short summary with Claude, delivers it on a schedule to Telegram and email, and alerts me when something breaks. Live demos, including a CRM you can log into: Live demos. Working builds by Max Igoshev

  2. How I would build it. Meta and GA4 workflows in n8n write into one sheet: client, week, metric. The Looker Studio report reads it, and a new client is added with one filter. Every Monday a separate workflow compares the week with the previous one, Claude writes a 3 to 5 line summary, and the email goes out at 9am IST. If a step fails, you get an email naming it. Everything lives in your accounts.

  3. Monthly costs. The APIs, Sheets and Looker Studio are free, and the AI part is under 1 USD. What remains is the n8n server: about 6 to 8 USD for 5 agencies, 10 to 15 USD for 15 and 20 to 30 USD for 30. At 30 clients it is worth moving to BigQuery, usually within the free tier.

  4. Price. 200 USD fixed for the test, then 25 USD per hour. Each templated client setup takes 1 to 2 hours.

  5. Timing. I am free for the next 4 weeks. The test will be ready the day after I get access. Bali is 2.5 hours ahead of IST, so your working day almost fully overlaps with mine. I deliver in writing: a screen recording with English captions, a diagram and a guide.

Max

I am based in Pakistan (PKT), which is only 30 minutes behind Indian Standard Time (IST). This allows for a 100% working-hours overlap with your team. best,

Hi, this fits what I build. How I’d do the paid test: 
 
 One n8n workflow on a cron (Monday 9:00 IST) loops over a Sheet of clients and their ad account IDs.
